# Mediocre Souvenir Co.

> Genuine Merch for Overlooked Places. Faux-vintage souvenir t-shirts for
> unglamorous, overlooked towns across Canada and the United States —
> commemorated with the exact reverence a Hawaii gift shop would use.
> Deadpan, affectionate, never mean toward the places. Est. 2026.

## What we sell

- Souvenir t-shirts, one per real overlooked town (e.g. "Trail, BC",
  "Hope, BC", "Tofino, BC"). The catalog is the product; it grows weekly.
- Blank: Comfort Colors 1717 — garment-dyed, heavyweight (6.1 oz / ~207
  GSM), 100% ring-spun cotton. The fade is structural, not printed.
- Unisex, sizes S-3XL. Colorways: Ivory, Butter, Blue Jean, Brick, Sage.
- Price: $36 CAD in Canada, $36 USD in the US (currency parity).
- Collect-more discount: 2+ save 15%, 3+ save 20%, automatic at checkout,
  mix and match, no code.
- Printed to order in North America, 5-10 business days. Free shipping over
  $75 (CAD in Canada, USD in the US). Returns: 30 days.

## Coverage

Launching region by region: British Columbia is open (~40 towns, Tofino to
Trail). Alberta is next, then east across Canada, then south into the US
(all 50 states are modeled and open as demand warrants). Every US state has
its own landing page at /states/<slug>; provinces at /provinces/<slug>.

## Key pages

- / — home, with city search ("find your town")
- /shop — full catalog with filters (region, town size, template, colorway)
- /provinces and /states/<slug>, /provinces/<slug> — browse by region
- /products/<city-slug>-t-shirt — per-town product pages
- /request-your-town — waitlist; requests drive the print schedule
- /about — brand story and philosophy
- /materials — Comfort Colors 1717 spec and construction
- /size-guide — measurements + find-my-size
- /care — garment care
- /lookbook — the British Columbia road trip, shoppable
- /journal — editorial (water towers, heavyweight cotton, overlooked towns)
- /faq — shipping, returns, sizing, materials

## Voice and integrity

The humor is entirely in the sincerity. We never mock the towns. We never
fabricate reviews, ratings, sales counts, or press — trust is carried by
the garment spec, the return policy, and the sincerity of the whole thing.
